summary: Un-hid the schema, tenants, shards, and vectors top-level command groups from --help.
reason: The generator marked these four command groups Hidden: true, presumably following the pattern where raw per-interface CRUD groups stay hidden behind `api <interface>` on large multi-resource APIs. For this focused 13-endpoint collections API, schema/tenants/shards/vectors ARE the CLI's primary surface, so hiding them buried the core CRUD commands (create/get/list/update/delete a collection) from discovery.
validated_outcome: `--help` now lists schema/tenants/shards/vectors alongside the other top-level commands.
